mainEntity.name: What kind of plumbing modifications are necessary for an outdoor sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing an outdoor sink requires extending existing water supply lines (hot and cold, if desired) and a drainage line from your home to the new sink location. This often involves trenching to bury pipes and connecting to your main plumbing system, typically through a wall or foundation. Depending on local regulations in cities like Oakland or Fremont, you might also need a backflow prevention device to protect your household water supply. Our team manages all necessary plumbing modifications to ensure proper function and code compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor sinks require extending water supply and drainage lines, often with trenching, and potentially a backflow prevention device. We handle all plumbing modifications.
